title: Frequently asked questions
fraseGuia: Before deciding, let's understand your case.

items.q: How much does the consultation cost?
items.a: The standard consultation costs between Gs 300,000 and 450,000 depending on complexity. It includes review, diagnosis, and a clear plan. No surprises.

I can orient you, but a photo isn't enough to indicate a treatment with seriousness. I need to evaluate clinically, the radiograph when needed, the gums, the bite, the history, and the expectations. To tell you what's best, I need to see you.

items.q: Why do I need a prior consultation?
items.a: Because the right treatment depends on the diagnosis. I prefer that you understand your case before making a decision. The Diagnostic & Planning Consultation is where we think your case through together.
First visit: 45–60 minutes. Follow-ups: 20–30 minutes. For specific procedures I tell you the exact time before we start.
Previous radiographs or studies, insurance card or coverage (for reimbursement), medication list, and questions written down so you don't forget.
Yes. Write to me on WhatsApp and we coordinate.

items.q: What if I don't need treatment?
items.a: If you don't need treatment, I'll tell you. I don't invent problems to charge more. My job is to evaluate honestly.
I'll send you access directions and where to park when we confirm the appointment.
Yes, when indicated. But first I evaluate whether they're really needed or whether a more conservative alternative exists. Aesthetics should not stand above biology.

items.q: Can treatment be done in stages?
items.a: Yes. In many cases it's the most realistic and responsible approach. The important thing is to order priorities: what to do first, what can wait, and what isn't worth doing.

Yes, especially. Cases where many variables must be integrated are the ones I enjoy most. Rehabilitation isn't placing crowns: it's restoring function, stability, aesthetics and confidence inside a mouth that has history.
Yes. If the case is very complex, I refer to a trusted endodontist. I don't do what I can't do well.
Simple extractions, yes. For wisdom teeth or surgical cases I work with trusted maxillofacial surgeons and coordinate everything.

items.q: Do you do crowns or bridges?
items.a: Yes. I use zirconia because it's the most resistant and biocompatible. I explain the options and you decide with full information.
From age 10–12. For younger children or specific behavioral needs I refer to a trusted pediatric dentist. I don't start if the child isn't comfortable.

My current focus is private care, with time for diagnosis, explanation, and planning. We issue detailed receipts with procedure codes for reimbursement with international insurers (BUPA, Cigna, GeoBlue) and local corporate plans.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash, bank transfer, and cards. For high-value cases we offer financing plans through Pagopar or Bancard. We discuss this at the consultation.
